scale.usable_n_evidence: entity article, Real numbers section: 'we retained a total of 4730 samples from 1519 participants. Of these, 1393 participants had plasma lipidome profiling since baseline.' [ref: PMC12269576]
scale.usable_n_for_request_reason: Of 1517 participants, the AD-vs-CN discriminator training set comprises 580 subjects (243 stable AD + 337 stable CN); for an AD biomarker validation buyer needing longitudinal AD cases with ≥2 timepoints, 329 MCI-to-AD converters + 243 stable AD = ~572 actionable AD-spectrum subjects. Comfortably exceeds n_target=200.
scale.multi_site_potential: Can be aggregated with aspree-dementia-casecohort-lipidomics (n=3495, same Baker Institute platform) for cross-cohort validation; same LC-MS/MS QqQ methodology enables direct comparison per PMC12269576.
scale.axis_summary: 580 usable AD-spectrum subjects with longitudinal data; exceeds 200 target; confidence medium because exact statin-naive subset size is not stated in the article.

source.evidence: pricing-data.md, Open Research Cohorts section: 'ADNI — Data access: free via LONI portal (https://ida.loni.usc.edu)'; entity article access_and_consent_scope: 'ADNI data are publicly available through the AD Knowledge Portal and the Laboratory of Neuro Imaging Image and Data Archive.'
source.note: Data access is free under DUA; the ADMC lipidomics layer may require a separate request — treat as 'free but DUA overhead' (~EUR 5K–15K legal/admin per pricing-data.md Gaps section).

screening_qa.evidence: No published price for ADNI lipidomics-specific QA re-run; statin covariate model must be applied by buyer or confirmed as pre-applied in the data download. Buyer QA effort not priced in wiki.
screening_qa.note: If buyer accepts the published statin-covariate-adjusted dataset without re-QA, cost is analyst time only (~EUR 2K–5K estimated); if buyer requires a clean statin-excluded re-extraction, quote required from Baker Institute.

assay.evidence: entity article: 'Lipidomic profiling in the ADNI study was performed on all plasma samples (n = 4730) using our recently expanded targeted lipidomic profiling strategy' [ref: PMC12269576]. Data are downloadable as metabolite concentration matrices.
assay.note: Buyer receives pre-processed metabolite data; no re-assay needed unless buyer requires raw instrument files or a fresh run on a different sub-cohort.

unknowns: DUA legal/admin cost (EUR 5K–15K estimated per pricing-data.md Gaps section)
ADMC/Duke University separate agreement cost (if required)
statin re-QA cost if buyer rejects covariate-adjusted data
cost.timeline: 2–5 months (DUA processing 2–4 months per entity article + data download ~2 weeks). Tight but possible within 6-month window if DUA starts immediately.
cost.axis_summary: Source is free; assay already performed; DUA overhead is the main cost driver at EUR 5K–15K. Well within EUR 50K budget even accounting for unknowns. Timeline is the greater risk — 6-month DUA-to-delivery is achievable but not guaranteed.

pre_analytical.fasting: documented — fasting rate 94.8–96.4% across diagnostic groups [ref: PMC12269576]; near-universal fasting is a strength for plasma lipidomics reproducibility
pre_analytical.tube_type: plasma confirmed; EDTA/heparin not specified in the primary paper — ADNI biospecimen protocol paper (Huynh et al. 2018) needed for tube type confirmation
pre_analytical.freeze_thaw: cycle count not stated in PMC12269576; ADNI biospecimen protocol paper referenced but not extracted into wiki yet — gap
pre_analytical.verdict: partial — fasting (load-bearing for lipidomics) is well documented; tube type and freeze-thaw cycles are gaps that should be confirmed before committing

confounders.medication_statins: EXPLICITLY DOCUMENTED: '423 lipid species significantly associated with statin usage (Supplementary Table S6)... after multiple testing correction' [ref: PMC12269576]. Statins are modelled as a covariate, not excluded. Buyer's hard negative 'statin-confounded samples not acceptable' requires buyer to confirm whether covariate adjustment satisfies their criterion.
confounders.medication_omega3: DOCUMENTED: '398 lipid species associated with omega-3 usage (Supplementary Table S7)' — modelled as covariate
confounders.apoe: DOCUMENTED: APOE ε4 % provided by diagnostic group; enriched above population frequency by ADNI recruitment design
confounders.verdict: partial — statins are the request's named hard negative; they are documented and modelled but NOT excluded from the sample set. This is the primary quality risk for this request.

platform_validation.external_replication: ASPREE (n=3495) on same Baker Institute platform confirmed ether lipid signal (C-index 0.75) [ref: PMC12269576]
platform_validation.verdict: good — cross-cohort replication on the same platform with a different disease definition (community dementia vs ADNI AD) confirms platform reproducibility

quality.axis_summary: Pre-analytical partially documented (fasting strong, FT cycles unknown); statins documented and modelled but not excluded — this is the dominant quality risk given the buyer's hard negative. Platform validated in ASPREE. Depth 0.57 = medium confidence.

card_for_delivery.primary_signal: 580 usable AD-spectrum subjects (≥200 target met) from ADNI-1/GO/2; plasma lipidomics already performed (Baker Institute, 781 species); data free under DUA; EUR 5K–20K all-in estimate vs EUR 50K budget.
card_for_delivery.action: Confirm with ADNI/ADMC whether the downloadable dataset includes statin-covariate-adjusted metabolite matrix; if so, start DUA application immediately at ida.loni.usc.edu to meet 6-month timeline.
card_for_delivery.risk: Statin hard negative: 423 lipid species affected; ADNI provides covariate-adjusted (not statin-excluded) data — buyer must confirm this satisfies 'not acceptable' requirement before proceeding.

scale.usable_n_evidence: entity article: 'N: 1,430 participants; 4,063 samples. Diagnostic breakdown: CN n=383, stable MCI n=423, MCI converters (CN→MCI) n=66, AD converters (CN/MCI→AD) n=294, AD n=264.' [ref: PMC12706616]
scale.usable_n_for_request_reason: AD converters (n=294) + prevalent AD (n=264) = 558 AD-spectrum subjects with longitudinal data; exceeds n_target=200. Baseline/12mo/24mo timepoints available for most, giving 3-point trajectory minimum.
scale.multi_site_potential: Can be combined with adni-go2-plasma-lipidomics for a multi-platform AD metabolomics bundle (lipidomics + broad metabolomics on overlapping ADNI-1/GO/2 participants); 68.25% cross-platform lipid replication rate documented internally [ref: PMC12706616].
scale.axis_summary: 558 AD-spectrum subjects usable; exceeds 200 target; confidence high (numbers directly quoted in entity article).

source.evidence: pricing-data.md: 'ADNI — Data access: free via LONI portal'; entity article: 'Access: AD Knowledge Portal for metabolomics data; LONI for clinical/demographic data; two separate DUA processes required.'
source.note: Two separate DUAs required (AD Knowledge Portal + LONI); legal/admin overhead may be EUR 10K–25K for dual-DUA vs single-DUA process.

screening_qa.evidence: No published price for ADNI serum metabolomics QA; estimate based on analyst time to apply the published Boruta medication-metabolite adjustment model (~2–5 days analyst effort at academic core rates).
screening_qa.note: Statin and medication confounders are documented via Boruta modelling (41 baseline + 21 longitudinal medication-metabolite associations); buyer may need to apply this model to the downloaded data or request the pre-adjusted matrix.

assay.evidence: entity article: 'The ADNI-1/GO/2 Longitudinal Serum Metabolomics Cohort (MXP Quant 500) is the largest longitudinal blood metabolomics study in Alzheimer's disease published to date.' [ref: PMC12706616]. Downloadable as metabolite concentration matrices at AD Knowledge Portal.
assay.note: Biocrates MXP Quant 500 kit data already generated; buyer receives 506 post-QC metabolite profiles per sample.

unknowns: ADMC/Duke data layer separate agreement cost (if required for MXP500 data)
statin re-QA cost if buyer requires a clean statin-excluded subset rather than covariate-adjusted
cost.timeline: 3–6 months (dual DUA 3–5 months per entity article + data download ~2 weeks). Tight for 6-month window; timeline risk is higher than for the single-DUA lipidomics cohort.
cost.axis_summary: Source is free; assay already performed; screening QA estimated EUR 2K–5K; dual DUA overhead EUR 10K–25K. Total EUR 12K–30K — within budget. Timeline is the dominant risk: dual DUA may push past 6 months.

pre_analytical.fasting: documented — non-fasting samples removed (n=284 samples, 15 subjects) per entity article; Met-So QC applied [ref: PMC12706616]
pre_analytical.tube_type: serum (not plasma); 10 µL aliquots; fasting serum confirmed
pre_analytical.matrix_note: SERUM not PLASMA — buyer specified plasma; serum is a close surrogate for targeted metabolomics but not identical for certain lipid species. Surface explicitly to buyer.
pre_analytical.freeze_thaw: not stated in entity article — gap
pre_analytical.verdict: partial — fasting documented and enforced (non-fasting removed); serum vs plasma matrix mismatch with buyer's request is the load-bearing pre-analytical concern

confounders.medication_statins: EXPLICITLY MODELLED: 'Medication confounding formally modelled by Boruta feature selection: 41 baseline and 21 longitudinal medication-metabolite associations identified.' [ref: PMC12706616]. Statins are among the medication covariates; not excluded from sample set.
confounders.dietary: NOT DOCUMENTED: 'Dietary intake and gut microbiome not captured — unresolved confound for bile acid and tryptophan pathway findings.' — gap for bile acid and tryptophan analyses specifically
confounders.apoe: DOCUMENTED: APOE genotype available as co-modality; ADNI APOE e4 enrichment applies
confounders.verdict: partial — statins modelled (not excluded) as in the lipidomics cohort; dietary confounding is an additional gap not present in adni-go2-plasma-lipidomics

platform_validation.cross_platform_replication: 68.25% of mappable lipids replicated in independent ADNI lipidomics dataset; persistent-class replication rate 85.51% [ref: PMC12706616]
platform_validation.verdict: good — strong internal cross-platform replication; no external cohort replication (weakness vs adni-go2-plasma-lipidomics which has ASPREE)

quality.axis_summary: Depth 0.62 (best of the two candidates); fasting enforced; serum not plasma (matrix mismatch); statins modelled not excluded; dietary confounding unresolved; strong internal platform replication but no external cohort. Quality confidence: high on documented dimensions, but matrix mismatch with buyer's 'plasma' requirement is unresolved.

card_for_delivery.primary_signal: 558 AD-spectrum subjects (AD converters n=294 + prevalent AD n=264); serum targeted metabolomics already performed (Biocrates MXP500, 506 metabolites); data free under dual DUA; EUR 7K–30K all-in estimate vs EUR 50K budget.
card_for_delivery.action: Confirm serum vs plasma acceptability with buyer; if acceptable, initiate dual DUA applications (AD Knowledge Portal + LONI) simultaneously; apply Boruta medication model to handle statin confounding in downloaded data.
card_for_delivery.risk: Serum matrix (not plasma as requested); statin confounding modelled but not excluded; dual DUA may push access timeline past 6 months.

axis_legend.scale: Usable N for THIS request, with confidence. Not headline N.
axis_legend.cost: Three legs (source + screening_qa + assay), explicit unknowns, no composite total when unknowns exist.
axis_legend.quality: Pre-analytical, confounders, platform validation, and provenance depth. Statin confounding is the buyer's hard negative and drives confounder verdicts.
